description: Bus Alarm - Autonomous college bus tracking with persistent geofence alarm notifications

userStories.title: Universal Local DB for Offline-First Storage
userStories.description: As a user on mobile or web, I want my saved tracking links and geofences saved locally without databaseFactory errors.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement AppDb interface with SqfliteDb for mobile and SharedPreferencesDb for web
LinkRepository and GeofenceRepository persist and retrieve items reliably across app restarts
Flutter analyze and tests pass with 0 errors
userStories.notes: Implemented AppDb with SqfliteDb on mobile and SharedPreferencesDb on web.

userStories.title: Resilient Link Activation and Non-blocking Save
userStories.description: As a user, I want saving and activating a link to succeed immediately without hanging or 400 errors from upstream provider.
acceptanceCriteria: Saving links in AddLinkScreen saves to local DB first and pops immediately
Backend handles upstream 502/network timeouts gracefully and accepts tracking sessions
Clicking Activate in Saved Links shows friendly error status without DioException stack dumps
Backend integration tests pass (24/24 passed)
userStories.notes: Fixed validate_share error recovery and clean error messages in ApiClient.

userStories.title: Vehicle Telemetry Polling and Freshness Indicator
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see the latest bus position and age of data on the dashboard.
acceptanceCriteria: Dashboard displays live vehicle telemetry with freshness indicator
Displays warning badge when telemetry age exceeds 60 seconds
Periodic poll refreshes coordinates without UI flicker
Flutter analyze passes with 0 issues
userStories.notes: Telemetry poller and freshness badge active on DashboardScreen.

userStories.title: Geofence Stop Proximity & Approach Crossing Alert
userStories.description: As a student waiting for a bus, I want an alert triggered when the bus enters or crosses my stop radius.
acceptanceCriteria: Point-to-segment crossing detection handles fast bus transit between samples
Cooldown window suppresses duplicate alerts for the same approach
Backend geofence tests pass with 100% coverage
userStories.notes: Backend geofence engine and tests passing.

userStories.title: Full-Screen Alarm with Dismiss and Snooze
userStories.description: As a user, I want an alarm screen with sound and vibration that I can Dismiss or Snooze when the bus arrives.
acceptanceCriteria: High-contrast full-screen AlarmScreen with Dismiss and Snooze actions
Snooze delays alarm trigger by 5 minutes
Dismiss records dismissed action and stops vibration/sound
Flutter analyze passes with 0 issues

userStories.title: Production Release Build & Packaging
userStories.description: As a user, I want the web bundle and Android build compiled and verified for release.
acceptanceCriteria: Flutter web release bundle builds into mobile/build/web without errors
Android release APK builds with minSdkVersion 26 (Android 8.0) to latest targetSdk 36
Backend runs cleanly with Uvicorn and passes all 24 test suites
README.md documents all installation and verification steps
userStories.notes: Web release built in mobile/build/web, Android release APK compiled at mobile/build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-release.apk (minSdk 26, targetSdk 36, 56.2MB), backend test suite 24/24 passing.
